ex.en: It is hard to keep our balance on icy streets.
ex.zh: 在結冰的街道上很難保持平衡。

ex.en: The icy road sparkled in the sunlight.
ex.zh: 結冰的路面在陽光下閃閃發亮。

ex.en: Many accidents resulted from the icy conditions of the road.
ex.zh: 路面結冰導致了許多事故。

ex.en: An icy wind blew into the room through the open window.
ex.zh: 一股寒風從開著的窗戶吹進屋裡。

ex.en: An icy blast of wind chilled me to the bone.
ex.zh: 一陣刺骨寒風讓我冷到骨子裡。

ex.en: She gave me an icy look.
ex.zh: 她冷冷地看了我一眼。

ex.en: His suggestion got an icy reception.
ex.zh: 他的提議受到冷淡的回應。

icy.en: unfriendly and showing no warm feelings

ex.en: Click the icon to open the app.
ex.zh: 點一下圖示就能開啟這個應用程式。

ex.en: Drag the icon to your desktop.
ex.zh: 把圖示拖到你的桌面上。

icon.en: a small picture on a screen that you click to open something

icon.zh: 偶像、代表性人物或事物

ex.en: She became a fashion icon in the 1990s.
ex.zh: 她在 1990 年代成為時尚偶像。

ex.en: The tower is an icon of the city.
ex.zh: 這座塔是這個城市的地標象徵。

icon.en: a famous person or thing that stands for an idea or a time

ex.en: Roger slipped on the ice and hurt his leg.
ex.zh: 羅傑在冰上滑倒，傷了腿。

ex.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.
ex.zh: 冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。

ex.en: Can I have a glass of water with no ice?
ex.zh: 可以給我一杯不加冰的水嗎？

ice.en: water that has frozen and become hard

ex.en: I want a cup of iced tea.
ex.zh: 我要一杯冰紅茶。

ex.en: I'll have an iced coffee, please.
ex.zh: 請給我一杯冰咖啡。

ice.en: made cold by having small pieces of frozen water in it

ex.en: I never have an ice cream without feeling happy.
ex.zh: 我一吃冰淇淋就很開心。

ex.en: I've got to stop eating such sweet ice cream.
ex.zh: 我得戒掉吃這麼甜的冰淇淋。

ice.en: a frozen sweet food made from milk and sugar

ice.zh: break the ice：打破僵局、緩和氣氛

ex.en: He told a joke to break the ice.
ex.zh: 他講了個笑話來打破僵局。

ex.en: Games are a good way to break the ice at meetings.
ex.zh: 玩遊戲是會議上破冰的好方法。

ice.en: to make people feel more relaxed when they first meet

ex.en: She spread white icing over the cake.
ex.zh: 她把白色糖霜抹在蛋糕上。

ex.en: The cupcakes had pink icing and small candies.
ex.zh: 這些杯子蛋糕有粉紅色糖霜和小糖果。

ex.en: Icing on the road made driving dangerous.
ex.zh: 路面結冰讓開車變得危險。

ex.en: Pilots check for icing on the wings before takeoff.
ex.zh: 飛行員在起飛前會檢查機翼是否結冰。

ex.en: Iceland is an island country in the North Atlantic.
ex.zh: 冰島是北大西洋上的一個島國。

ex.en: Many tourists visit Iceland to see hot springs and glaciers.
ex.zh: 許多遊客前往冰島欣賞溫泉和冰河。

ex.en: The ship hit an iceberg in the cold sea.
ex.zh: 那艘船在寒冷的海上撞上了冰山。

ex.en: Only a small part of an iceberg is above the water.
ex.zh: 冰山只有一小部分露出水面。

ex.en: I'd like an iced coffee with no sugar, please.
ex.zh: 我想要一杯不加糖的冰咖啡。

ex.en: She sipped iced tea on the porch.
ex.zh: 她坐在門廊上啜飲冰茶。

ex.en: The iced cupcakes were decorated with tiny stars.
ex.zh: 這些裹了糖霜的杯子蛋糕用小星星裝飾。

ex.en: Kids love iced cookies at birthday parties.
ex.zh: 孩子們在生日派對上都愛糖霜餅乾。

ex.en: The Eiffel Tower is an iconic landmark of Paris.
ex.zh: 艾菲爾鐵塔是巴黎的代表性地標。

ex.en: That red dress became an iconic image of the film.
ex.zh: 那件紅洋裝成了這部電影的經典意象。

ex.en: The band is famous for its iconic songs.
ex.zh: 這個樂團以經典歌曲聞名。

ex.en: She studies the iconography of medieval churches.
ex.zh: 她研究中世紀教堂的圖像象徵。

ex.en: The film's iconography borrows from old comic books.
ex.zh: 這部電影的視覺符號借用了老漫畫。

ex.en: We tried traditional Icelandic food on our trip.
ex.zh: 我們旅行時嚐了冰島的傳統食物。

ex.en: The Icelandic landscape is full of volcanoes and glaciers.
ex.zh: 冰島的景色到處是火山和冰河。

ex.en: She is learning Icelandic before moving to Reykjavik.
ex.zh: 她在搬到雷克雅維克前正在學冰島語。

ex.en: Icelandic is hard for many English speakers.
ex.zh: 冰島語對許多說英語的人來說很難。

ex.en: A long icicle hung from the edge of the roof.
ex.zh: 一根長長的冰柱從屋簷邊垂下來。

ex.en: The children broke off an icicle and watched it melt in their hands.
ex.zh: 孩子們折下一根冰柱，看著它在手中融化。
